title: CyberChef
descript: CyberChef is a web-based "cyber swiss army knife": encode, decode, encrypt, hash, parse and transform data with more than 400 operations that you drag into a recipe. Handy for base64, JWT, hex, gzip, timestamps and log parsing. Recipes and data are processed in your own browser - the NAS only serves the static page and the developer receives nothing.
release_note: 11.6.0-1: remediation of the listing review (C3/C4/C5/C6/C7/T1). Upgraded to upstream CyberChef 11.6.0 - current nginx base image and current bundled JS dependencies, which addresses the scanned CVEs; added a complete privacy policy linked from Help; the description now discloses the three opt-in network operations; licence metadata corrected; README expanded.
important: Requires DockerEngine (auto-installed if missing). Everything runs in your browser: input and recipes never reach the container or the developer. Only three optional operations use the internet: HTTP request (the URL you type), DNS over HTTPS (Google or Cloudflare) and Show on map (unpkg.com + OpenStreetMap tiles). The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access. No user content is stored on the NAS.

zh-cn.descript: CyberChef 是网页版的「数据处理瑞士军刀」：把 400 多个操作拖成配方，就能做编码/解码、加解密、哈希、解析与格式转换。处理 base64、JWT、十六进制、gzip、时间戳、日志都很方便。配方与数据都在你自己的浏览器里处理——NAS 只负责发送静态页面，开发者不会收到任何数据。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。所有运算都在浏览器本地完成：输入与配方不会发到容器，也不会发给开发者。只有三个可选操作在使用时会访问外网：HTTP request（你填写的网址）、DNS over HTTPS（Google 或 Cloudflare）、Show on map（unpkg.com + OpenStreetMap 瓦片），除此之外不发起任何请求。界面为纯 HTTP，若要从外网访问请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。NAS 上不保存任何用户内容，因此没有需要备份的数据。
zh-cn.release_note: 11.6.0-1：针对上轮审核意见的整改（C3/C4/C5/C6/C7/T1）。升级到上游 CyberChef 11.6.0——新的 nginx 基础镜像与当前版本的 JS 依赖，修复扫描报告中的 CVE；新增完整隐私政策并由「帮助」链接；描述中如实说明三个可选的外网操作；修正许可证信息；补全 README。

zh-hk.descript: CyberChef 是網頁版的「資料處理瑞士軍刀」：把 400 多個操作拖成配方，就能做編碼/解碼、加解密、雜湊、解析與格式轉換。處理 base64、JWT、十六進位、gzip、時間戳、日誌都很方便。配方與資料都在你自己的瀏覽器裡處理——NAS 只負責傳送靜態頁面，開發者不會收到任何資料。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。所有運算都在瀏覽器本地完成：輸入與配方不會傳到容器，也不會傳給開發者。只有三個可選操作在使用時會連上外網：HTTP request（你填寫的網址）、DNS over HTTPS（Google 或 Cloudflare）、Show on map（unpkg.com + OpenStreetMap 圖磚），除此之外不發出任何請求。介面為純 HTTP，若要從外網存取請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。NAS 上不儲存任何使用者內容，因此沒有需要備份的資料。
zh-hk.release_note: 11.6.0-1：針對上輪審核意見的整改（C3/C4/C5/C6/C7/T1）。升級到上游 CyberChef 11.6.0——新的 nginx 基礎映像與現行版本的 JS 相依套件，修復掃描報告中的 CVE；新增完整隱私政策並由「說明」連結；描述中如實說明三個可選的外網操作；修正授權資訊；補齊 README。

data_notes: CyberChef is a static browser application: every operation runs in the browser tab, the container only serves files and keeps no documents. /data is an empty placeholder so the app has its own TOS data directory; recipes live in your browser's localStorage.
design_notes: **Client-side only.** Every operation runs in the browser; input, recipes and output are never uploaded.
**No telemetry.** The packaged build contains no analytics, no account and no update check.
**Runs as uid 1000.** The nginx-based image serves static files on port 8000 unprivileged.
**Image pinned to v11.6.0** (multi-arch amd64+arm64), upgraded for the nginx/dependency security fixes.
limitations: - Pure client-side tool: no server-side history or sharing between devices.
- HTTP request, DNS over HTTPS and Show on map need internet access and fail offline (by design).
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access.
- Very large inputs are limited by browser memory.
